capabilities: Draw custom gestures with the floating action button to trigger any command
Show context-aware toolbars that change based on cursor position and selection
Assign tap, long-press, and audio-record commands to the FAB
Force the tablet UI on phones and toggle a wake lock
Run incremental selection and cursor movement commands
extras: Installation is only documented through BRAT, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's mobile interface has limited touch controls, with no way to trigger commands via gestures or get toolbars that adapt to the editing context.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT from the Community Plugins in Obsidian.

summary: Mobile interface enhancer that adds a floating action button, shape-drawing gesture commands, and context-aware editing toolbars.
